geography_match.method: Exact provider state and county text normalized only for the documented Co. county abbreviation, then resolved to one active county-equivalent registry entry; coordinates were not used

temporal_scope: Preserved specimen event recorded as 1906-08; validated event year 1906.
spatial_scope: Historical physical specimen occurrence assigned from explicit provider county geography in MA; not a complete inventory of the county.
caveats: Historical preserved specimen evidence supports recorded presence only.

Source silence, excluded cultivated records, missing geography, and every rejected row create no absence or non-detection claim.
